Feminine ei/mi/lita/anna alternatives are not presented as wrong distractors; standalone noun practice separately accepts authored masculine/feminine alternatives. Phrase stages assess meaning and agreement only. Sources consulted for grammar principles: Språkrådet grammatical gender; NTNU NoW grammar chapters 4, 5, 6. All text and level choices still require qualified native review.

focus.label: viktig: Things that matter
focus.summary: Adjectives ending in -ig do not add t in neuter singular. Use viktig in both singular genders and viktige in plural.

focus.label: annen: Another possibility
